home.title: Football predictions built on probabilities, not hunches
paragraphs: IASHARK produces football predictions from statistical models (Poisson, Dixon-Coles, Elo ratings and Monte Carlo simulation). For the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, the Bundesliga, Ligue 1, the Champions League and the other competitions we cover, the model estimates the probability of each result, the number of goals and both teams to score, then compares it with the probability implied by bookmaker odds.

These are statistical estimates: football is uncertain, no outcome is guaranteed and IASHARK is not a bookmaker. Data coverage varies by league, so every analysis shows its data-quality rating. 18+ only.
